subject: Next steps: technical deep dive — confirm time & attendees

Subject: Post-discovery: proposed windows for technical deep dive and attendee ask

Hi Jamie & Daniel,

Great to meet earlier — appreciate the clarity on your latency and data isolation requirements. Per our call, next best step is a 60-minute technical deep dive with your engineering and security leads. To keep momentum, proposing two time windows next week (all PDT):

- Option A: Tue Mar 23, 10:00–11:00 AM PDT
- Option B: Wed Mar 24, 2:00–3:00 PM PDT

Could you confirm which slot works and who from Atlas will join? Specifically, it would be helpful to have:
- 1x engineering lead (infra/network)
- 1x security/compliance owner (SOC 2 / data flow)
- 1x product owner or PM (for success criteria)

If neither window fits, send 2–3 times that work for you and we’ll adapt. I’m copying Monica (solutions lead) who will run the deep dive.

Attached: a short mutual action plan and the demo deck so attendees can skim ahead.

[Attachment: mutual_action_plan_ATL.pdf (PDF, 550 KB)]
[Attachment: redwood-demo-deck.pdf (PDF, 2.1 MB)]
